title: High vacuum dual thruster spinner test, about 2.5 millinewtons

tellings.quote: What we have here is a vacuum test highlighting actual movement in vacuum using a dual thruster pack in the vertical spinner orientation.

plain: Charles Buer, a guest on Jesse Michels's podcast, says a video shows a test in a vacuum chamber in Florida, where a pack of two thrusters mounted on a vertical spinner moved with no air around it. He puts the push at about 2.5 millinewtons, a very tiny force, and if true it would mean a new kind of propulsion that does not rely on ordinary rocket exhaust.
